Both are on the consolidated TTM-to-Jun-2026 basis (not the standalone 79 cr figure). App's 211.34 cr does not reconcile with either the consolidated (267) or standalone (79) screener figures, and sits between FY2026 annual 'Net Income' (177.29 cr) and 'Net Income Including Noncontrolling Interests' (224.65 cr) from the app's own /income statement (collected lines 777-801) -- an unexplained ~21% understatement of TTM bottom-line profit against the best-corroborated outside value, with no basis label shown.

Three different windows (annual, mrq, TTM) are all legitimate and none is 'wrong' -- this is the exact trap the pack calls out, not a new defect.

Pack documents 5 reachable sources giving 5 different TTM EPS values (1.75-5.76) with no internally consistent basis across any of them. App's 4.84 is a 6th value inside that already-disputed spread (closest to stockscans' 4.90). No single canonical outside truth to diff against.
